title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

2 days p/w on site in Milton Keynes minimum
Contract until the end of the year

Technical Skills.

  • Expert in Data Bricks, ADF & SQL (SQL queries, SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) (Stored Procedures Development).
  • Must be an expert in Microsoft Azure
  • Asset Bundles in Databricks
  • STAR Schemas
  • Medallion Architecture expert
  • Expert in MS Fabric
  • Expert in Data Modelling & Data Schema creation including measures, calculations, KPI's & CDE's
  • Understanding of database management systems and ETL (Extract, transform, load) framework
  • Understanding of MS Azure data lake design (e.g. dimensional modelling) and data mining

Business Skills

  • Proven abilities to take initiative and be innovative
  • Analytical mind with a problem-solving aptitude
  • Ability to coach and influence end users / business area data analysts.
  • Ability to work well within a team
  • Ability to work in an agile environment where not all facts are known up front.
